description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Protecting Our Kids press conference to highlight Roy Cooper’s failure of letting transgender men into our daughters bathrooms and sports. Whatley highlighted Roy Cooper’s record of vetoing legislation to ban these men from playing in girls sports and being in their locker rooms, along with his vetoes of legislation to prohibit transgender mutilation surgeries for children and the Parents Bill of Rights.
